name: EL2244 / EL2444 (Elantec/Intersil dual/quad high-speed video op-amp)
tagline: Elantec's dual 120 MHz, 325 V/us video op-amp that Chinese and Korean op-amp-swap guides rank beside the AD827 for neutral, wide, detailed sound.
technology: Voltage-feedback, unity-gain-stable, low-power high-speed op-amp built on Elantec's proprietary complementary bipolar process. The EL2244 (dual) and EL2444 (quad) are multi-channel versions of the single EL2044. They have a 120 MHz GBW, 325 V/us slew rate and 5.2 mA per amplifier.

part_numbers.notes: Base part number for the dual. Early Elantec datasheets call it EL2244C.
Pb-free 8-pin SO on 13-inch tape and reel. Listed in FN7059.2.
Base part number for the quad. Early Elantec datasheets call it EL2444C.
Pb-free 14-pin SO. Tape-and-reel variants appear in FN7059.2.

lineage.notes: Designed as the dual/quad of the EL2044 on Elantec's complementary bipolar process. Ordering codes EL2244CN/CS and EL2444CN/CS.
Intersil acquired Elantec in 2002 and reissued the datasheet as FN7059, whose copyright line reads 2002-2004. It added the Pb-free Z ordering codes.

lineage.role: current owner of the Intersil portfolio
lineage.notes: Alldatasheet hosts a Renesas-branded EL2244 datasheet. The lifecycle status on renesas.com is not confirmed.

key_specs.value: 2.5 V to 36 V single supply (about +/-1.25 V to +/-18 V)

reputation.summary: This summary comes from the earlier discovery sweep and was not re-checked in this pass. Chinese sound-card and car-head-unit modding (摩机) guides, including the Baidu Tieba 40-op-amp list, PCPOP, 360doc and book118, rank it with the AD827 among the best voltage-feedback duals. They describe a neutral tone, a soundstage slightly wider than the OP275, and strong treble and resolution. The same guides criticise a thin midrange, light bass and bland musicality, and call it hard to use well. A Korean digipine tone summary also lists it. All of this is subjective forum and guide opinion.
typical_uses: op-amp swaps in PC sound cards
DIY I/V and buffer stages in CN/KR hobby builds
caveats: It is a 120 MHz, 325 V/us video op-amp, so tight decoupling and a careful layout are needed. Oscillation risk in sockets and adapters fits the guides' 'hard to use well' remark.
Input noise of 15 nV/rtHz is high compared with dedicated audio op-amps.
The praise is subjective and comes from CN/KR modding sources only.
The part is probably obsolete, so it is supplied mainly from old or broker stock.

counterfeit_notes: This check found no specific counterfeit or remarking reports. The part is old and probably obsolete, and CN audio-mod buyers get it mainly from brokers and the secondary market. Treat DIP and SO stock with unverified provenance, including Elantec-marked parts, as at risk of being remarked or relabelled. Pb-free 'Z' parts are a separate part number, not a die change.
alternatives: EL2044 (single-channel member of the same family)
AD827 (dual high-speed video op-amp the guides rank alongside it)

open_questions: Current lifecycle status on renesas.com (probably obsolete) was not confirmed.
The print date of FN7059.2 was not established, nor whether a later Renesas-era revision exists.
Is FN7059.0 the 'August 2002' version mentioned in one search summary?
Elantec revisions before Rev C (Dec 1995) are unknown. Did the Elantec-era title or specs quote a different bandwidth? The draft recalled '60 MHz', which may be a -3 dB bandwidth figure; unconfirmed.
No PCN, die change or fab transfer was found. The Elantec-to-Intersil-to-Renesas transfers and the Pb-free conversion are not documented as silicon changes.

refuted_claims: The draft technology note called it 'roughly a 60 MHz class part'. The FN7059 datasheet title and text give a 120 MHz gain-bandwidth product. No 60 MHz figure was found.

claims_confirmed: The Intersil datasheet is FN7059, titled 'EL2244, EL2444 Dual/Quad Low-Power 120MHz Unity-Gain Stable Op Amp'; a FN7059.2 copy exists (http://www.manuallib.com/download/pdf14/INTER-IL-EL2244-EL2444-DATA-SHEET.PDF)
FN7059.1 is dated July 14, 2004 with copyright Intersil 2002-2004 (https://datasheetspdf.com/pdf/1437145/Intersil/EL2244/1)
It is the dual/quad version of the EL2044 on Elantec's complementary bipolar process: 325 V/us, 120 MHz GBW, 5.2 mA per amplifier (https://datasheetspdf.com/pdf/1437145/Intersil/EL2244/1)
It runs on a single supply from 2.5 V to 36 V (https://datasheetspdf.com/pdf/1437145/Intersil/EL2244/1)
An Elantec EL2244C/EL2444C datasheet Rev C dated December 1995 exists (https://www.sm0vpo.com/_pdf/amplifiers/EL2244.PDF)
Input noise is 15 nV/rtHz at 10 kHz, 25 C (https://www.sm0vpo.com/_pdf/amplifiers/EL2244.PDF)
FN7059.2 lists the Pb-free EL2244CSZ, EL2244CSZ-T13 and EL2444CSZ (http://www.manuallib.com/download/pdf14/INTER-IL-EL2244-EL2444-DATA-SHEET.PDF)

The Elantec ordering codes EL2244CN, EL2244CS, EL2444CS and EL2444CN exist (https://www.datasheetq.com/EL2244CN-doc-Elantec, https://www.alldatasheet.com/datasheet-pdf/pdf/59896/ELANTEC/EL2244CS.html, https://pdf.datasheet.live/69509328/intersil.com/EL2444CN.html)
